تستنجبون (form X)
# تَسْتَنْجِبُونَ (tastanjibūna) /tas.tan.d͡ʒi.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
# تُسْتَنْجَبُونَ (tustanjabūna) /tus.tan.d͡ʒa.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
